name: tabletop-battle-tracker
description: Initiative and combat tracker for tabletop roleplaying games.

scripts.add:android: npm run build && cap add android
scripts.add:ios: npm run build && cap add ios
scripts.open:android: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.open:ios: npm run sync && cap open ios
scripts.apk: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
